items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: She was a great entertainer, and he was, too.

ctx.x: He told us all about it. We interviewed him. We interviewed him. And his wife, too. And his wife, Nettie. Yeah, singer, of course.
Yeah, they stayed together. They made quite a feel of that entertainment. She was a great entertainer, and he was, too. And so I'm sorry to hear that he had this stroke.
Yes, he's got him all right. He's doing pretty good.
